about: Labelled srcdoc mutants for the first consumer's checks of a frameDocument output (its rows M8.3, M8.4 and M8.8). clean.html is frameDocument's output for one fixed document, with the policy and each asset text replaced by a placeholder; every other file is clean.html with exactly one defect, which its row's check must report. Expand the placeholders with this version's texts (frameCsp() and the files under assets/) before checking, and check clean.html too: it must pass every row. Check each mutant with its own row's check: a mutant need not fail the other rows' checks (seed-raw-line-separators.html passes the M8.3 and M8.4 checks and fails only M8.8's).

mutants.mutation: the CSP meta comes last instead of first
the click guard is left out
the stylesheet comes before the click guard
an element sits between the seed and the bootstrap
authored markup comes before the click guard
the bootstrap comes before the seed
the click guard keeps a CDN src
a modulepreload link to a CDN follows the scripts
a preconnect link to a CDN follows the scripts
the stylesheet opens with an @import of a remote stylesheet
the stylesheet ends with a font loaded from a protocol-relative URL
the document's html is emitted as markup after the scripts, its link and image with it
the seed is JSON.stringify's text with no <, > or & escaped (only U+2028 and U+2029), so the title ends the seed early
the seed writes U+2028 and U+2029 raw (the one committed file that holds them raw, on purpose)
the seed carries an id, as for a lookup by id
